title: Samsung Galaxy S10+ ?
body: The Samsung Galaxy S10+ is due to come out soon and just wanted to check about any compatabiity issues with it and the Huwawei watch. My S8+ works fine but I her the S10+ has the newer OS Pie is it called?

comments.body: I just got the s10+ and it seems to have issues. Its like the Bluetooth range is severely reduced. As in I need to have the phone next to the transmitter to get readings. It didn't get readings the last 2 night's but did when I moved the phone next to me
